pages.text: Bia is a magical brown teddy bear who came to life. She's cheerful, playful, and always full of energy.$(br2)She has soft brown fur and loves making others smile. You can find her house in the birch forest.

pages.title: Bia Spawn Egg
pages.text: Craft with an X-Pill, brown wool, and an egg.
$(o)Tame Item$()$(br)Bia loves $(#fa8072)Salmon$(). It's her favorite treat!$(br2)$(o)Scenes$()$(br)$(li)Anal$(li)Doggy Style
